reuse.why: Every month-wide action, including the new one, goes through categoriesForMonthBudgetAction, and the new action reuses amountForAverageBudget, getSheetValue and setBudget.

duplication.why: The category SELECT with the new notes join is pasted into setZero, setLastMonthSpending and the three average actions instead of a shared loader, and setLastMonthSpending copies the average actions' loop.

placement.why: The selection rules (hidden, template, #fixed, include flag) all live in month-budget-categories.ts and the handler is registered in budget/app.ts beside its siblings.

scope.why: Changes serve the four steps; only a stray blank line in the import block is incidental, though copyPreviousMonth is not given the new flag.

maintainability.why: The rule is centralised, but adding a column to the selection now means editing five identical SQL strings, and copyPreviousMonth's argument shape drifts from the others.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions call categoriesForMonthBudgetAction; none filters categories on its own.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated SELECT ... LEFT JOIN notes blocks and the setLastMonthSpending loop are literal copies, not reshaped.

abstraction_drift.where: categoriesForMonthBudgetAction dropped its per-action switch and gained one includeHiddenCategories flag; the template and #fixed rules are uniform conditions, and every action calls it.
